body.statement: Under \(\texttt{ass:oracle-separation}\), the retained empirical family equals the population active projection-and-branch family with probability tending to one, and the conditional critical value \(c_{n,1-\alpha}\) differs by \(o_{P_n}(1)\) from the oracle face-envelope critical value that knows this family.
body.justification: The theorem shows that uniform protection has no first-order critical-value cost on regular separated faces.
body.gap: Generalized moment selection handles slack inequalities, but not simultaneous support release and nested ratio branches in this explicit capacity map.
body.consumer: Applied users obtain ordinary smooth-face precision when Job Corps cells are well separated while retaining protection when they are not.
